༄༅/ /bod yul lho de wi ko ṭa'i gnas bshad mdor bsdus ya mtshan gyi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bod yul lho de wi ko ṭa'i gnas bshad mdor bsdus ya mtshan gyi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ("$ 1ba2)༄༅// gsang chen rgyud nas bsngags pa'i zla shel ri// mkha' 'gro'i char sprin rtag tu 'du bas su// skal med gnam the'i dpa' bkong snod ldan pa'i// mgrin sngon rab dga' 'brug sgra'i gter der 'dud// yang dag par sbyor ba dang*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang*/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho la sogs pa bla na med pa'i rgyud gzhung mtha' yas pa nas mig ni de wi ko ṭa ste zhes bshad pa/ nang mig gnyis kyi phyir de wi ko ṭa'i gnas gnyis yod pa'i mig g.yas pa dang sbyar ba de ni/ rgya gar shar phyogs pā ḍa li pu tra zhes pa chos kyi rgyal po mya ngan med pa'i yul de na yod la/ g.yon dang sbyar ba'i gnas de 'di'o// 'di la phyi sku'i 'khor lo sprul sku za byed las kyi mkha' 'gro gnas sa bzhi yod de/ shar mon kha seng ge na rings bdud rtsi sman gyi ljongs yod pa/ bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad sel ba'i sman thams cad skye ba/ dkar mo sku'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi las byed ma rnams rtag tu myul ba/ lho na sbas yul mkhan pa ljongs/ rtsi bcud 'bras bu'i tshal yod pa/ longs spyod rgyas pa'i dpal thams cad bskyed pa/ ser mo rgyas pa'i mkha' 'gro ma'i las byed ma rnams rtag tu myul ba/ nub na sbrul mtsho pad+ma gling*/ g.yu mtsho slob dpon chen pos 'gugs byed phyag gi rgyas spras pa yod pa/ dmar mo dbang gi mkha' 'gro'i las byed ma rnams rtag tu myul ba/ byang du smra bo cog po sgrol byed gnam lcags 'bar ba'i rdo rje sa la zug pa lta bu yod pa/ ljang mo las kyi mkha' 'gro'i las byed ma rnams rtag tu myul ba/ de dag rnams bsam gtan pa'i drod myul zhing skal med tshar gcod pa myul le ma rnams kyi gnas te sprul pa sku'i zhing ngo*// de dag gi nang du gsung gi 'khor lo longs sku 'jig rten gyi ḍā ki ma gnas pa'i gnas bzhi yod de/

shar phyogs su 'od gsal gyi rdzong*/ rdo rje phag mo gar mdzad pa lta bu/ zhi ba'i las rab (2na3)'byams bsgrub pa'i gnas/ nyon mongs pa'i sprin 'od gsal gyi dbyings su zhi bar byed pa/ lho phyogs su dpal seng ge'i ri ro bcud kyi sman thams cad skye ba lha'i dga' ba'i tshal lta bu/ rgyas pa'i las rab 'byams bsgrub pa'i gnas/ dbang phyug chen po'i longs spyod thams cad kyis phyug par bskyed pa/ nub tu tshel ma dpal gyi ri 'chi med tshe'i bum pa lta bu/ dbang gi las rab 'byams bsgrub pa'i gnas/ 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsi 'bab pa/ byang du dpal mkho mthing lha khang bod khams spyir gyi mi bsrun pa zhud pa'i sa de gnon pa lha khang che po sprul pa'i chos kyi rgyal pos rdzu 'phrul gyis bsgrubs pa/ slob dpon chen po pad+mas chos dang longs spyod kyi gter kha bsam gyis mi khyab pa bcas pas da lta bod 'bangs thams cad la phan bde'i khungs su gyur pa/ phyis rgyal ba lo ras pa sogs smad 'brug gi bstan pa'i dar sa/ drag po las kyi gnas/ de'i nang du chos sku ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro'i gnas dung gi brag ri ngos la lcags phur can rdo rje btsun mo rnams kyi bha ga chos thams cad kyi 'byung gnas kyi yul chen po/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma sam+bha wa dang*/ gnubs nam mkha'i snying po/ bod kyi mkhan po sba ye shes dbang po/ rje btsun ras chung zhabs/ lhag par chos kyi rgyal po gtsang pa rgya ras kyis bdud kyi g.yul chen po btul nas phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub brnyes par mdzad pa/ 'di'i nang gi mchod rten mgo lnga pa bod khams la mtha' dmag bzlog pa'i rten 'brel du/ slob dpon gyis lung bstan/ gter ston chen po gu ru chos dbang gis bzhengs pa yang gter dpag tu med pa bzhugs/ phyi'i mchod rten dam pa ra zhig gis bsgrubs/ brag 'di la gter kha bsam gyis mi khyab/ lha mo mkhar dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po'i thabs kyi liṅga phul byung rig pa'i ye shes/

gnyis su med par snyoms par 'jug (2ba4) ri byang chub kyi snying po skal ba dang ldan pa la me long la pra phab pa lta bur gsang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo thams cad ris med par 'char ba/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad bde blag tu rnyed par 'gyur ba/ dpal gyi phug rings dkyil 'khor chen po grub pa'i gnas slob dpon chen po pad+mas rje 'bangs nyer lnga la/ sgrub pa chen po bka' brgyad kyi dbang bskur/ gnubs nam mkha'i snying pos yang dag gi dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa brag seng ge dkar mo gnam du mtshong ba lta bu khams gsum zil gyis gnon pa/ dur khrod la kha dpa' bo dang dpa' mo thams cad tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i gnas/ gzhan dpal le phug dang*/ rdo rje phug dang*/ yid smon phug pa/ rgyal ba rgod tshang pas/ snang srid lha 'dre thams cad dam la btags sa dang gzhan dkyil 'khor phug /ro snyoms phug /nyi zla phug /khyung phug la sogs pa phug chen brgya rtsa brgyad/ ljon shing ngo mtshar can brgya rtsa brgyad/ chu sna brgya rtsa brgyad kyis gang ba kun khyab rdzu 'phrul btsan gyis legs par skyong ba 'di/ da lta bod kyi yul na ngo mtshar ba thams cad kyi dkyid gnyis pa'o// zhes pad+ma dkar pos gnas kyi ngo mtshar ba'i 'phrul gsal bar mthong nas sbyar ba dge legs su gyur cig// /sarba maṅga laṃ/// /chos sbyin rgya cher spel ba'i ched/ bar bzhengs glegs bu re re la/ dngul krang yon 'gyed mdzad po ni/ chos rgyal bsod nams rgyal mtshan no/// /
